# tenzir_secret (Resource)

A secret that pipelines read with `secret("<name>")`. An organization, a workspace or a deployment holds it: the most specific of `organization_id`, `workspace_id` and `deployment_id` that is set. A deployment reads the closest secret of a name.

The value is write-only, so it never reaches the state; this needs Terraform 1.11 or later. The platform counts every write in `version`. When it changes outside Terraform, the next apply writes the configured value again. To change the value, change `value` and bump `value_version`.

Needs `createSecret` and `listSecrets` on the owner (`Organization`, `Workspace` or `Deployment`), and `update` and `delete` on the secret (`OrgSecret`, `WorkspaceSecret` or `DeploymentSecret`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "splunk_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# Every deployment of the organization may read this one.
resource "tenzir_secret" "splunk" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  name            = "splunk_token"
  value           = var.splunk_token
  value_version   = 1
}

# Only the deployments of the SOC workspace see this one.
resource "tenzir_secret" "soc_splunk" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
  workspace_id    = tenzir_workspace.soc.id
  name            = "splunk_token"
  value           = var.splunk_token
  value_version   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) The name pipelines read the secret by.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `value` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The value. Write-only: Terraform sends it but never stores it.

### Optional

- `deployment_id` (String) The ID of the deployment that holds the secret. Needs `workspace_id`.
- `readable_by` (Attributes) Restricts which deployments may read the secret. Without it, every deployment that the owner reaches may read; with it, only those listed, and none when both lists are empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--readable_by))
- `value_version` (Number) Change this to write a changed `value`, which Terraform cannot see by itself.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID or slug of the workspace that holds the secret, or that the deployment belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The secret ID.
- `version` (Number) How often the platform has written the secret.

<a id="nestedatt--readable_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `readable_by`

Optional:

- `deployments` (Set of String) IDs of deployments that may read.
- `workspaces` (Set of String) IDs of workspaces whose deployments, including future ones, may read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization>/<name>, <organization>/<workspace>/<name>, or
# <organization>/<workspace>/<deployment>/<name>.
terraform import tenzir_secret.splunk acme/splunk_token
terraform import tenzir_secret.soc_splunk acme/soc/splunk_token
```
